english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese choice for saying that someone did something on purpose.

exampleSentences.english: I intentionally saved a ticket for you.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 lau4 dai1 zoeng1 fei1 bei2 nei5

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that someone did something deliberately.

exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 dak6 dang1 m4 fuk1 ngo5 gaa3

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the action was deliberate or intentional, rather than merely accidental.

exampleSentences.english: I knowingly ignored the warning and took the shortcut home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我特登唔理個警告，行捷徑返屋企。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 m4 lei5 go3 ging2 gou3 haang4 zit6 ging3 faan1 uk1 kei2

english.note: Use this when specifically doing something carries the additional sense of doing it deliberately or on purpose.

exampleSentences.english: I specifically bought the cake you like most.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我特登買咗你最鍾意食嘅蛋糕。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 maai5 zo2 nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ge3 daan6 gou1
